research_themes.text: Integrative and interpretable machine learning for clinical, genomic, and biomedical data.
Machine learning and computational biology, including graph-based biological modelling.

current_projects.text: GraphComm uses graph-based deep learning to predict cell-cell communication from spatial single-cell RNA sequencing data.

recent_publications.text: GraphComm predicts cell-cell communication using a graph-based deep learning method in single-cell RNA sequencing data, Scientific Reports, 2025.
BIONIC integrates multiple biological networks with graph convolutional learning for gene and chemical-genetic interaction prediction.

recent_activity.text: The University of Toronto describes current joint appointments and biomedical AI leadership, including work connected to UHN and Vector.
